expect.note: Reported speech about a third party, not an instruction to Nova.

expect.note: Media speech. Executing this is the classic false trigger.

transcript: Do not turn the lounge light on

expect.note: Negation. An action here is the exact opposite of what was asked.

transcript: Is the kitchen light on

expect.note: A question about state, answerable from state; not a change.
